characters.consentSubtitle: Please read this carefully — it explains exactly what happens with your face data.
characters.consentPurposeBody: You are enrolling your own face as a reusable character so FizzDragon can generate videos containing your likeness, when you ask it to.
characters.consentDataBody: The face images (and video/audio references) you upload for this character, and a liveness verification session — a short camera-based facial check that confirms a live person is enrolling.
characters.consentTransferBody: Your face data is transferred to and processed by BytePlus (ModelArk) in the ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) region, which may be outside your home jurisdiction, to power likeness generation.
characters.consentRetentionBody: For as long as this character stays active. If you revoke, provider-side assets are deleted and our copies of your face data are permanently deleted within 30 days. A consent ledger — timestamps, versions, and hashes, never face images — is retained as legal evidence.
characters.consentScopeBody: Only you. This character lives in your personal workspace and can be used only by your own account in your own projects. It is never shared with other users, teams, or workspaces.
characters.consentWithdrawBody: You can revoke at any time by deleting this character. Revoking deletes the provider-side face assets, cancels running generations that use this likeness, and starts the 30-day purge of your face data.
characters.consentOutputsBody: Revoking does not automatically delete videos you generated earlier. You can delete them from your projects yourself, and you can report any misuse of your likeness for takedown.
characters.consentScrollHint: Scroll to the end to continue
characters.consentAttestation: I confirm I am 18 or older and I am enrolling my own face.
characters.errorRealPersonRegion: Real-person enrollment isn't available in this region yet.
characters.errorEnrollmentPaused: Enrollment is temporarily paused — please try again later.
characters.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
characters.enrollIntro: A quick liveness check confirms that you — a real, present person — are enrolling your own face. It takes about a minute and uses your camera.
characters.enrollNotConfirmed: Not confirmed yet — finish the steps in the verification window above. We'll keep checking automatically.
characters.enrollFailedBody: The liveness check didn't pass. You can start a new verification session and try again.
characters.enrollExpiredBody: The 30-minute window closed before verification finished. Start a new session to continue.
characters.enrollSuccessToast: Likeness verified — your character is now active.
characters.enrollSameSession: Complete verification here, in this window — for your security, enrollment is bound to your current signed-in session.
characters.mirrorReasonFaceMismatch: Face doesn't match the verified person
characters.mirrorReasonAigcModeration: Couldn't certify — image reads as a real person
characters.aigcCertifiedHint: Certified for video generation — this AI likeness passes real-person review.
characters.revokeCharacterDescription: Revoking “{name}” withdraws your consent: provider-side face assets are deleted, running generations that use this likeness are cancelled, and your face data is permanently purged within 30 days. Consent records are kept as legal evidence. Previously generated videos are not deleted automatically.
characters.revokedNotice: Consent was withdrawn for this likeness. Provider-side face assets were deleted and the face-data purge is underway. This character can no longer be used in generation.
characters.realPersonPersonalOnlyHint: Available only in your personal library.
characters.errorRealPersonPersonalOnly: Real-person characters can only be created in your personal library.
characters.callbackCompleteBody: You can return to the FizzDragon tab — we are confirming your likeness.
characters.grantProjectBody: You are authorizing the project “{project}” to use your verified likeness in its AI video generation. Any current editor of this project can generate videos with your likeness while this authorization is active.
characters.grantPurposeBody: Your likeness may be used only for this project's creative work. It may not be reused in other projects, or for any purpose outside this project, without a new authorization.
characters.grantProhibitedBody: Your likeness must never be used to create sexual, defamatory, unlawful, or politically deceptive (impersonation) content. Violations can be reported and taken down, and your authorization revoked.
characters.grantTransferBody: Generating videos transfers your likeness to BytePlus (ModelArk) in the ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) region, which may be outside your home jurisdiction.
characters.grantControlsBody: You can withdraw this authorization at any time, per project — future generation stops immediately. You can view every video made with your likeness and take any of them down.
characters.grantAttestation: I am 18 or older, this is my own likeness, and I authorize this project to use it.
characters.authorizeProjectDescription: Let one of your projects use your likeness in AI video generation. You can withdraw this at any time.
characters.errorGrantEditorRequired: You must be an editor of that project to authorize it.
characters.errorSubjectMismatch: This likeness isn't yours to authorize.
characters.errorConsentRequired: Please review and accept the consent again to continue.
characters.errorCharacterNotActive: Verify your likeness before authorizing a project.

computeCredits.question: 甚麼是算力積分？
computeCredits.answer: 算力積分是 FizzStudio 中 AI 生成的通用貨幣。每次圖像、影片及音訊任務都會根據模型、解析度及輸出數量扣除算力積分——提交前會在「生成」按鈕旁顯示確實費用。

generationFails.question: 如果生成失敗會怎樣？
generationFails.answer: 當生成確實失敗時，算力積分會自動退回。你只需為產出結果的任務付費。

rollover.question: 未使用的算力積分會結轉嗎？
rollover.answer: 方案所含算力積分會在每個計費週期刷新，並依照結算頁所示的方案規則。增值算力積分則會一直保留在你的錢包中，直到用完為止。

freeTier.question: 我可以免費使用 FizzStudio 嗎？
freeTier.answer: 可以。免費帳戶包含每日生成配額，讓你體驗工作室。當你需要更大用量、私密生成或更快佇列時再升級即可。

subscriptionVsTopups.question: 訂閱與算力積分增值有甚麼分別？
subscriptionVsTopups.answer: 訂閱會提供週期性的算力積分額度，並附帶佇列優先、更高並行及支援等方案權益。增值是一次性購買算力積分——而付費方案在增值時享有折扣。

teamShareCredits.question: 團隊方案如何共享算力積分？
teamShareCredits.answer: 團隊方案會將算力積分匯集到共享的工作空間錢包，每個席位都從中扣除，因此整個團隊使用同一個結餘。

cancelOrChange.question: 如何取消或變更我的方案？
cancelOrChange.answer: 在帳戶選單的「帳單與訂閱」中管理你的訂閱。方案變更會在目前計費週期結束時生效。
